supersedes: R3-A ablation priority. Ablation is checkpointed in experiments/GR/R3A_CHECKPOINT.md and is not expanded. Local R4 depth transfer is not this recipe and is not promoted.
claim_limit: Report measured cells only. q=1024 per layer is a reference budget, not a proof that the optimizer converged. A minimal q is relative to that reference. n=1000 standard error is not optimizer accuracy. No hardware affordability claim. No universal win.

ansatz.nov3: original Nov3rd: one shared gamma, one shared thetaK, one shared thetaM for every layer, three polynomial shell parameters per layer, interleaved packing, no per-layer gamma
ansatz.fidelity: squared overlap on the energy-selected state, post hoc

hamiltonian.form: sum_{i<j} J_ij Z_i Z_j - B Z-field replaced by - B_star sum_i X_i
hamiltonian.J: i.i.d. normal(0, 1/sqrt(N)), variance 1/N, row-major upper triangle, shared by every method, L, and q
hamiltonian.B_star_meaning: per-instance refined maximizer of the balanced-cut ground-state entropy. Not an assumed thermodynamic critical field.
hamiltonian.entropy: nats, natural log, Schmidt probabilities from singular values squared, drop <= 1e-300

primary_scan.refine: bounded minimize_scalar xatol 1e-6 on neighboring grid points

hamiltonian.edge_policy: If the scan max is on a boundary, extend the window (low side /4 down to 1e-4, high side *2 up to 48) up to 6 times with overlap. Unresolved boundary or a failed positive-even GS contract is a prep failure for that seed. Do not replace the seed and do not pick a nearby interior point.
hamiltonian.gs_contract: positive amplitudes (min > -1e-8), even parity, residual <= 1e-7, gap > 0, delta_odd > 0, delta_even > 0. A tiny odd-sector gap is recorded and is not itself a failure. Exact GS data are used only for field prep and post-hoc metrics.

packing: interleaved [[a, a+N/3, a+2N/3] for a in 0..N/3). N in this campaign is divisible by 3. Odd-N cut indexing is a conformance check only.
shell: s1*p + s2*C(p,2) + s3*[p==3], same polynomial as N3X_matched_v1, not the Walsh chart

starts.start0: deterministic: Nov3 gamma=0.25 and other controls 0; QAOA every angle 0.25
starts.start1to3: Nov3 gamma, thetaK, thetaM ~ U(-0.5,0.5), shells ~ U(-0.3,0.3); QAOA each angle ~ U(-0.5,0.5)
starts.rng: SeedSequence([seed, N, round(10*B_star), L, method_id, start_id, stream]) with stream 0 SPSA and stream 2 init. q is not part of the seed.
starts.budget_coupling: A smaller q follows the same four starts and stops earlier. It is not a fresh restart. Selection uses only the points that run charged.

spsa.a_from_median: median |g|/sigma over 4 calibration perturbations, initial step 0.5 sigma

budget.meaning: q is the per-layer query rate. The inclusive total is q*L, not a flat 1024.
budget.halving: every candidate is run down to the accounting floor. Degradation is measured, not used to skip a cell.
selection_points: polyak mean of last min(64,T) iterates
budget.runnable_if: Q divisible by 4, per_start = Q/4 >= 16, and (per_start-12) even so T>=2
budget.accounting_floor: smallest candidate q that is still runnable at that L. q=8 and below never fit L<=6.
diagnostics_outside_Q: one post-hoc energy recomputation of the selected x

order: Finish dev 10000-10009 for one N, write FREEZE_n{N}.json, then that N's final seeds, then the next N. N increases 6,9,12,15,18. Do not wait on LE, FT, or local.
immutable_v1: After this preregistration is committed, the ansatz, SPSA allocation, and halving grid are v1. Dev outcomes and later ideas do not edit a running panel. A later idea is a new recipe id with its own evaluation.

dev.role: this cloud only. All L, all runnable q, both methods, before finals of that N.

final.role: opened only after that N's dev rows are on disk and FREEZE_n{N}.json matches this protocol sha with retuned=false

tolerance_rule: For each stage, N, L, method, and tolerance tau, q_star(tau) is the smallest runnable q such that every runnable q'>=q has |mean paired (F(q')-F(1024))| <= tau. Also report the 95% CI of that paired difference (1.96 * sample sd / sqrt(n), ddof=1). If the CI half-width exceeds tau, say the tolerance is not resolved at this n. q_star does not delete final cells. The final grid stays the preregistered runnable grid.

replay_gate.hard: abs energy difference <= 1e-8 and abs a_gain difference <= 1e-9
replay_gate.note: At L=1 and q=1024, Q=1024 and the 4-start split matches N3X_matched_v1. A miss stops the campaign.

failures: Preserve the traceback, retry a deterministic job once, then keep the failure record. Do not drop a seed because its fidelity is low. Do not replace a prep failure.
